# KING AI — Canonical Public Facts

Website: https://www.kingai.work
Official GitHub: https://github.com/kingaiwork
Public knowledge repository: https://github.com/kingaiwork/KINGAIASE-public
Business: vip@kingai.work

Brand: KING AI
Unified core system: KING AI SEA
Category: Intelligent Agent System / Intelligent Lifeform Platform
Chinese category: 智慧生命体与智能体系统
Core loop: Think · Remember · Plan · Coordinate · Act · Observe · Learn · Evolve · Govern

Definition:
KING AI is a long-term intelligent-agent system combining persistent intelligence, memory, knowledge, mission planning, specialized AI roles, governed digital work, developer interoperability and AI-native computing.

KING AI SEA:
The unified persistent intelligent-lifeform and agent core within KING AI. It is the mother system for long-term continuity, memory, knowledge, missions, planning, agent coordination, Personal Intelligence, Enterprise Intelligence and AI Workforce.

Official ecosystem:
- KING AI SEA — unified core system — active long-term development.
- KING AI Intelligence — public research and technology channel — Available.
- KINGAIBOT — controlled terminal execution layer — In Development; public v1.2.0 foundation.
- KINGAI OS — AI-native Server/Desktop/IoT operating-system project — In Development; D4 Developer Foundation / Pre-Alpha.
- KING AI Online Tools — 130+ bilingual browser utilities — Available / Live.
- KING AI Auth Lite — no-payment account and verified-email foundation — In Development / deployment validation.
- Personal Intelligence — personal second-brain expression — In Development / Custom-by-Scope.
- Enterprise Intelligence — enterprise expression — Custom-by-Scope / product framework.
- AI Workforce — enterprise operating model using specialized AI roles — Custom-by-Scope / product framework.
- AI Employees — specialized digital roles inside AI Workforce.
- Developer & Integration — APIs, connectors, interoperability and embedded intelligence — In Development / Custom-by-Scope.
